reason: The exact allowed external lem-prh explicitly assumes k,n >= 1, but the root contract states no positivity/nonzero-domain premise for k or n, and neither def-positive-approximate-retract nor def-stochastic supplies it. The definition just converts positive unital maps to probability-vector rows; it does not establish k,n >= 1. Therefore the assertion that A and M are exactly the structural kind required by lem-prh omits a genuine lemma premise. If zero-dimensional l-infinity spaces are intended to be excluded, that convention must be made explicit; otherwise the zero-dimensional case requires a separate argument before lem-prh can be applied.
